name: American Express Plenti® Card
notes: American Express states that the Plenti loyalty program ended on July 10, 2018, with all Plenti program accounts closed and unredeemed points expired. That page is not a card-specific withdrawal notice, but this card's only rewards currency was Plenti points, so with every Plenti account closed the Plenti Credit Card cannot still be offered: status is discontinued (checked 2026-10-21). The card-specific end date comes only from a cardholder letter quoted by Doctor of Credit (secondary source: "On February 16, 2018, the Plenti Credit Card will be discontinued, and as a result, your Card Account will be cancelled"); with no issuer-domain copy, discontinued_date is left unset. No successor or conversion was offered per that letter, so replaced_by is unset. The old card URL returns a generic shell and the checked servicing URL returns 404. Historical fees and rewards remain unverified. Card art provenance (checked 2026-10-21, secondary source, lower confidence): no usable official issuer image was found, so this is a local upload under the repo's option-C convention (image.provenance.source "other"; the sha256 is of the downloaded file). The source page and image URL are listed in secondary_sources. Match: Amex EveryDay-style Plenti Credit Card from American Express face on the card's review page. The artwork remains the copyright of the issuer; it is for identification only and is not evidence of lifecycle or financial fields.
